name: Work-from-home customer service representative (TTEC Canada)
summary: TTEC, a large outsourced customer-service company, posts permanent work-from-home phone and chat support jobs for Canadian residents, usually limited to certain provinces.
whatYouDo: You answer customers of a client brand (e.g. a luxury retailer, automotive or healthcare account) by phone or chat from home, using the client's systems and following quality and speed targets. Work is scheduled in shifts and measured on performance metrics.
appeal: Postings are explicitly remote for people living in Canada
Posted roles are permanent and full-time (employee, not gig)
Chat-only representative postings exist for people who prefer text
Bilingual (French or Spanish) postings exist for language skills
watchOuts: Each posting limits eligible provinces: one remote role excluded BC and Ontario residents, another chat role was open to BC residents
Posted base pay seen was modest: $17–$18/hr on a remote luxury-retail role
Employee reviews (anecdotal) mention micromanagement, pay complaints, stress and rushed training
A reviewer describes company equipment as basic and says it must be returned on leaving
Healthcare/senior postings require prior call-centre experience

training.notes: Training details not seen in sources reached.

compensation.notes: Base wage on one remote luxury-retail posting (ttecjobs.com, seen via search summary). Other postings' pay not seen.

reliability.notes: Luxury-retail posting says all positions are permanently remote and full-time. Openings and eligible provinces change per client program.

applicationSteps: Search Canada openings on ttecjobs.com and check the eligible-province list on each posting
Apply online through the specific posting
Complete TTEC's screening and interview steps (details not confirmed)
Treat any offer that asks you to pay for equipment or arrives from a non-TTEC address as suspect
fitsIf: You want a steady employee job doing phone or chat support from home and live in one of the provinces a posting accepts.
notFitIf: You need high pay, dislike scripted metric-driven work, or live in a province a posting excludes.
